why_this_is_a_decision_and_not_a_technic: The goal requires the same-named gow binary to be compiled from an ordinary directory of this main module without a nested go.mod, and forbids leaving go install github.com/tx7do/... behind. Doing that literally adds the 47 modules above to go-wind-admin/go.mod.

Two standing boundaries forbid exactly that: 不恢复 pgx/sqlc/OPA/GORM (11 gorm.io/* modules would come back into the graph, and AGENTS.md records the GORM assembly as removed) and 所有仍存活的非tx7do依赖保持T00所选版本 (these are not in the T00 selection at all).

The goal's own escape clause for a tool that cannot live in the main module says to stop and report the concrete conflicts rather than upgrade libraries or substitute another approach, which is what is recorded here.

The alternatives all cross a different boundary: a nested module under tools/ (explicitly forbidden), copying gorm/atlas/ent source into tools/localdeps and path-rewriting it (the sanctioned tool-local remap is described only for the tx7do go-utils v1.1.37 closure, and re-hosting those libraries is far beyond 只接管锁定版本必要源码), or keeping the external go install (explicitly forbidden by T13).
